text.zh_CN: 这市场疯了吧？！营收同比增长两成、EPS 明明超出华尔街一致预期，结果开盘冲高两分钟就一路砸出长上影大阴线！好财报凭什么暴跌？！
text.en: Is this tape insane?! Revenue grew 20% YoY and EPS beat Wall Street consensus — yet it spiked for two minutes at the open and slammed down into an ugly upper-wick red candle! How does a beat crash?!

speaker.zh_CN: 老陈 · 交易大厅前辈

text.zh_CN: （拧开保温杯吹了吹茶叶）新人都觉得股价考的是‘及格没有’。错啦！如果全市场提前一个月把股价推涨了 25%，赌它能考 98 分，结果它只考了 92 分——哪怕 92 分是优等生，那多出来的预期也得当场吐回去。行话叫：买预期，卖事实（Sell the News）。
text.en: (Unscrewing his thermos) Rookies think stocks are graded pass-or-fail. Wrong! If the street bid a stock up 25% all month pricing in a 98, and it prints a 92 — even if 92 is an A, that excess expectation gets puked right back at the open. Buy the rumor, sell the news.

text.zh_CN: 还不止如此。翻开财报中心的管理层指引（Guidance）和毛利率细项看看：上季度的利润只是后视镜，下季度指引下调、毛利率滑坡、或是资本开支（CapEx）激增吞噬自由现金流，任何一项都会触发机构估值模型重算。
text.en: And look deeper in the Earnings Center at forward Guidance and Gross Margin: last quarter's EPS is the rearview mirror. A guidance cut, margin slip, or CapEx surge eating free cash flow forces institutional DCF models to re-price immediately.

text.zh_CN: 如果你在财报前追高买了虚值期权就更痛了。财报落地瞬间，隐含波动率从 1.5 倍瞬间坍塌（IV Crush）——就算方向猜对但涨幅不够大，看涨期权照样亏钱。
text.en: And if you bought expensive OTM options right before earnings, it hurts twice. The second numbers drop, implied volatility collapses — IV Crush. Even if you guess the direction right, a modest move still loses money on calls.

text.zh_CN: 经历首个财报季的‘预期差洗礼’后，你在财报季的交易准则是：
text.en: After witnessing expectations-vs-reality in Earnings Season, what rule do you adopt?

text.zh_CN: 先看前期涨幅与下季指引毛利，绝不单看标题盲目追高。
text.en: Check prior run-up, forward guidance & margins first — never chase headlines.

toast.zh_CN: 研究进化：建立‘预期差 + 前瞻指引’财报框架
toast.en: Framework unlocked: Expectations gap + forward guidance

text.zh_CN: 警惕财报前高昂隐波，善用交易台‘今日动因’复盘每根K线。
text.en: Respect pre-earnings IV surge & use the 'Why Moving' banner to audit candles.

toast.zh_CN: 研究进化：掌握波动率回落（IV Crush）与动因溯源
toast.en: Framework unlocked: IV Crush defense & causal attribution

text.zh_CN: 当你开始问‘市场已经把多少好消息计入价格（Priced In）了’，你就真正跨过了散户与专业投资者的分水岭。
text.en: The day you start asking 'how much good news is already priced in?' is the day you cross the divide from retail spectator to real investor.

speaker.zh_CN: 老陈 · 交易大厅前辈

text.zh_CN: 懂盘口的人从不怪市场‘无端下跌’。把鼠标移到 K 线图每一根异动蜡烛上看看动因，每一滴眼泪背后都有账可查。
text.en: Tape readers never blame 'random drops'. Hover any big candle on the chart to read its causal attribution — every drop of blood on Wall Street leaves a receipt.
